title: Moses’ Signs and Reluctance

questions.question: What did God turn Moses' staff into as a sign?
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:3 (ESV): "He said, 'Throw it on the ground.' So he threw it on the ground, and it became a serpent."

questions.question: Who did God appoint to speak for Moses?
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:14-16 (ESV): "Is there not Aaron, your brother, the Levite?... He shall speak for you to the people."

questions.question: What was Moses' main objection to God's call?
options: He was not eloquent, slow of speech
questions.correctAnswer: He was not eloquent, slow of speech
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:10 (ESV): "O my Lord, I am not eloquent... but I am slow of speech and of tongue."

questions.question: How did the Israelites respond when Aaron told them what God said?
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:31 (ESV): "And the people believed... they bowed their heads and worshiped."

questions.question: What did Moses take with him when he returned to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:20 (ESV): "And Moses took his wife and his sons... and took the staff of God in his hand."

questions.question: What happened to Moses' hand when he put it inside his cloak?
options: It turned leprous, then was healed
questions.correctAnswer: It turned leprous, then was healed
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:6-7 (ESV): "Put your hand inside your cloak... it was leprous like snow... Put your hand back... it was restored."

questions.question: What was the third sign God gave Moses if the first two were not believed?
options: Turning water from the Nile into blood
questions.correctAnswer: Turning water from the Nile into blood
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:9 (ESV): "If they will not believe even these two signs... take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground, and the water... shall become blood."

questions.question: What did God say He would harden?
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:21 (ESV): "But I will harden his heart, so that he will not let the people go."

questions.question: What did God call Israel in relation to Himself?
Who met Moses on the mountain of God after he left Midian?
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:27 (ESV): "The Lord said to Aaron, 'Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.' So he went and met him at the mountain of God."

questions.question: What did God nearly do to Moses at a lodging place on the way?
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:24 (ESV): "At a lodging place on the way the Lord met him and sought to put him to death."

questions.question: Who circumcised Moses' son to avert God's wrath?
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:25 (ESV): "Then Zipporah took a flint and cut off her son's foreskin."

questions.question: What did Zipporah call Moses after circumcising her son?
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:25 (ESV): "She touched Moses' feet with it and said, 'Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.'"

questions.question: What warning did God tell Moses to give Pharaoh if he refused?
options: Egypt would be destroyed by fire
God would kill Pharaoh's firstborn son
questions.correctAnswer: God would kill Pharaoh's firstborn son
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:23 (ESV): "If you refuse to let him go, behold, I will kill your firstborn son."

questions.question: What question did God ask Moses when he complained about not being eloquent?
questions.explanation: Exodus 4:11 (ESV): "Who has made man's mouth? Who makes him mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Is it not I, the Lord?"

key_verse_text: Then the Lord said to him, ‘Who has made man’s mouth? Who makes him mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Is it not I, the Lord?’
